name: Yogaraja
dates_notes: Usually placed in the eleventh century as the commentator on Abhinavagupta's *Paramārthasāra*.
core_thesis: Yogarāja's *Paramārthasāravivṛti* is a substantial exposition of Abhinavagupta's concise account of non-dual Śaivism. The commentary clarifies the *Paramārthasāra*'s presentation of the limited subject, bondage, and liberation in the Trika framework, including its emphasis on liberation while living. Yogarāja is therefore not only a transmitter of Abhinavagupta's text: his commentary is one of the principal surviving interpretive guides to that work. This entry confines itself to that secure textual role pending a local passage-verified witness.

engaged_works.title: Paramarthasara-vivrti
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Securely transmitted as Yogarāja's commentary on Abhinavagupta's *Paramārthasāra*.
engaged_works.summary: A detailed Sanskrit commentary on Abhinavagupta's *Paramārthasāra*. Modern editions and an annotated English translation of the text with Yogarāja's commentary exist; no verified local primary-text witness has yet been associated with this record.
